This is retrospective classification of a completed cycle, not early warning.

sections.content: Retrospectively estimate whether the documented hydraulic cycle shows pump leakage from cycle-level physical sensor features.
sections.name: objective

sections.content: Smart Laboratory Report Generator; UCI hydraulic condition-monitoring experimental test rig; 17 documented sensor channels; 60-second cycles. Source: UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems (DOI 10.24432/C5CW21). Attribution requested: Helwig, Pignanelli, and Schütze, “Condition Monitoring of a Complex Hydraulic System Using Multivariate Statistics,” IEEE I2MTC 2015, DOI: 10.1109/I2MTC.2015.7151267.
sections.name: materials

sections.content: Sensor rows were aligned positionally using the UCI documented row-as-cycle convention. Per-cycle mean, population standard deviation (ddof=0), minimum, maximum, RMS, 25th percentile, median, and 75th percentile were computed independently at each channel's native sampling rate. The fitted pipeline uses the 14 physical channels only; profile targets and virtual channels CE, CP, SE are excluded from prediction. Scaling was fitted on the training partition only; the classification threshold was selected on validation data. This is retrospective classification using full-cycle sensor summaries, not a pre-cycle forecast or early-warning result. Native rates: PS1-PS6/EPS1 100 Hz, FS1/FS2 10 Hz, TS1-TS4/VS1/CE/CP/SE 1 Hz.

sections.name: results

sections.content: Predictions are model outputs, not direct laboratory measurements, certified diagnoses, or maintenance instructions. Data come from one experimental rig; source files have no timestamp/run identifier, and the time purge does not establish independent cycles. Sensor feature summaries are derived values, not raw measurements.
